description: This JavaScript file provides utility functions for user authentication in a React frontend, including sign-up, sign-in, password reset, OAuth login, sign-out, and error handling, all interacting with the Supabase backend.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with email, password, and optional metadata, with email redirect URL configuration.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Signs in a user with email and password.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Sends a password reset email with redirect URL.

methods.name: signInWithMagicLink
methods.description: Signs in a user using a magic link (OTP) email.

methods.name: signInWithOAuth
methods.description: Signs in a user via OAuth provider with redirect URL.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the current authenticated user.

methods.name: handleAuthError
methods.description: Handles authentication errors by showing toast notifications and redirecting the user.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's data.

methods.name: getCurrentSession
methods.description: Retrieves the current authentication session data.
